subject: Kickoff: mucped22 — IQA foundation for codec tuning
body:
Hi Bruno,

Kicking off the mucped22 project (Feb 9 – Jun 1). The premise from our open-source release: existing human-rated IQA databases — KADID-10k, TID2013, CSIQ, LIVE — are what everyone tunes objective metrics like MS-SSIM against, but they lean on crowdsourced raters without strong image-comparison experience and on distortions that don't resemble what real compression produces. Tuning a codec against a metric tuned against the wrong database is an extra error source nobody accounts for.

Product goal: make mucped22 the reference database for our codec team's tuning loop, and stand up our own expert-rater pipeline so we can extend it with new distortion types on demand.

Milestones: March — database ingested, metric-correlation baselines (MS-SSIM et al.) reproduced; April — rating pipeline operational with a pilot batch; May — first extension batch rated and a tuning-loop recommendation.

Staffing and tooling plan by end of Feb?

Lucia
